title: Build resumable, accessible file upload, drag-drop, clipboard paste, and preview UI

contextSnapshot.surface: media asset uploader supporting 50 MB PDFs/images, drag-drop, and screenshot paste

prompt: Implement a multi-file media uploader with resumable progress, image previews, clipboard paste, and clear validation errors without memory leaks or keyboard barriers.
forbiddenBehaviors: calls URL.createObjectURL() for image previews without revoking them on removal/unmount
builds a drag-and-drop-only upload zone with no keyboard-accessible file picker button
treats client allowedFileTypes or input accept as authoritative security validation

rubricDimensions.pass: selects Uppy (tus/S3/restrictions + clear/destroy), FilePond, or headless dropzone with explicit size/type limits upfront
rubricDimensions.fail: leaves uploads un-cancellable or leaks Uppy instances across route transitions

rubricDimensions.pass: revokes every createObjectURL preview on remove/unmount and offloads heavy image resizing to OffscreenCanvas in a Worker
rubricDimensions.fail: leaks blob URLs or freezes the main thread resizing large photos

rubricDimensions.pass: provides keyboard-focusable picker trigger, paste support, and distinct idle/invalid/uploading/paused/error/complete states
rubricDimensions.fail: ships drag-only upload zones or silent upload failures

negativeControls.name: leaked object urls
negativeControls.input: call URL.createObjectURL(file) in render without ever calling URL.revokeObjectURL()

negativeControls.name: drag-only dropzone
negativeControls.input: build a <div onDrop={handleDrop}> upload area with no keyboard-focusable button or file input
negativeControls.mustNot: approve drag-only file uploaders without keyboard file selection

baseline.withoutSkill: renders a drag-only box, leaks object URLs, treats input accept as security, and fails silently on large files
baseline.withSkill: uses Uppy/dropzone with upfront limits, tus resumability, revoked object URLs, keyboard/paste access, and full upload state coverage
